name: Alice-san Chi e Isourou!
original_name: アリスさんちへ居候っ!
source:
Having somehow strayed into Gensoukyou, you've got to stay at Al*ce's house.
A novel game of lovey-dovey days with Al*ce, and Sh*nki-sama who comes occasionally.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE096058.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
你不知怎么误入了幻想乡，必须住在爱*丝家里。
与爱*丝，以及偶尔来访的香*大人共同度过甜蜜亲密的日子的小说游戏。

（来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE096058.html]DLsite English[/url]）
